what: The declared search-free invariant instrument: the manuscript's raw pair-count profiles priced against the simulated homophonic encodings under the declared partition and encoder rule, the destroyed-adjacency floors and the plaintext controls, using only relabeling-invariant summaries of the pair matrices, so that no number here passes through any assignment search. The declared truthful question: do the manuscript's raw pair profiles sit inside the range of the simulated encodings on every declared invariant in every (file, language) cell, or is at least one invariant outside. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading.

invariants.sorted_symbol_marginals: the 37 symbol marginals (row sums) as a multiset, stored sorted descending as counts and as shares of the profile's own total, the two vector summaries envelope-tested by sorted position
invariants.sorted_pair_multiset: the 1369 pair counts as a multiset, stored sorted descending as counts and as shares of the profile's own total, envelope-tested by sorted position
invariants.empty_type_count: the number of the state space's pair types with zero counted occurrences, a scalar tested inside the band's [min, max] and recorded beside both totals because the count is tied to the profile's size
invariants.self_pair_share: the diagonal sum over the total
invariants.top_k_shares: the share of the total carried by the k largest pair counts, at the declared k values 1, 10 and 50
invariants.pair_entropy: the natural entropy of the pair distribution over the 1369 types in nats per counted pair

declared.state_note: the real's profile prices its transcription's kept-adjacent mapped pairs (unmapped events break adjacency and are not counted), while an encoding's profile prices every adjacent pair of its full stream; the two totals are disclosed beside every cell and every share-valued invariant normalises by its own total; the empty type count is a raw count tied to its own total and its verdict position is recorded in that context; the latin band's members are the roster's own truncated texts (every member's total recorded with it), standing property of the roster disclosed in every prior artifact, so the latin envelopes are size-mixed by the roster's own declared construction
declared.machinery_rule: this instrument contains no assignment search anywhere: no candidate evaluation, no restarts, no sweep cap, no convergence flags; the standing budgets are not applicable and no machinery recording appears for that reason
declared.split_rule: no split applies: a profile uses every counted pair of its stream, the real's kept-adjacent structure and the encodings' full-stream structure; the climb and score halves of the band instruments have no counterpart here
declared.seed_kinds: the declared encoding and floor kinds replay at their frozen positions: the members' selected draws through the homo_cross_enc kind at their member position, the plants through the homo_plant_enc kind at their index and the floors through the homo_floor_perm kind at their index; no new seed kind and no new position
declared.seed_sharing: no machinery streams exist in this instrument and none are consumed; every encoding is a byte-identical replay of its declared frozen draw from the frozen widened band's and the standing cells' own seed kinds
declared.band_record_rule: the simulated band is the frozen widened roster's 45 selected-draw encodings (7 english and 8 latin per language cell): each member's profile is its selected draw's encoding replayed through the declared encoder and partition, the selected draw read from the frozen artifact rather than re-derived because re-derivation is machinery; membership unconditional exactly as declared before
declared.plants_rule: the 30 plant encodings (5 per cell, the standing first references through the declared partition and encoder at the standing kinds) recorded as the instrument's own simulated calibration set, each cell recording its standing source's truncated length (a fact the predecessors never stored frozen, disclosed as new here) and a plants_at_source_identity boolean checking every plant's total equals its source length minus one; no parity rule applies because there is no anchor geometry to exceed: the plant's profile is its own encoding's matrix
declared.floors_rule: the 30 destroyed-adjacency floors recorded with their profiles; their declared role is the shuffled-structure control recorded beside the verdict, not part of any envelope
declared.plaintext_rule: each cell records the truncated standing reference's own plaintext stream profile computed by the same formulas on its own 27-type state (729 types), as the prose control beside the verdict; its state width differs by declaration and it takes no part in any envelope
declared.verdict_rule: declared strict-all: a cell is shape-consistent-with-homophonic-encoding only when every declared invariant of the real's profile sits inside the closed range of that cell's simulated band's profiles (the two vector summaries term by term inside the band's per-position envelope, the scalar summaries inside [min, max] at the stored 6-decimal rounding); any outside invariant makes the cell shape-outside-analogues, and every outside entry is recorded with its band range so the miss is audited not summarized
declared.closure_rule: no scalar margin is formed: this instrument's question is inside or outside per invariant, and the recorded distances are the outside entries' band ranges themselves
declared.exclusion_rule: the family's declared exclusion format is not re-scoped by this artifact: it keys to the declared 36-slot class under the inherited add-one form exactly as the held-out screen declared it, so a search-free verdict is structure evidence and the band instruments' verdicts stand untouched by this artifact's numbers
declared.bridge_gate: before any profile is priced, every fact this instrument re-derives fresh that the frozen restart-budget artifact already recorded must equal that stored value field for field: the six cells' counted pairs, all 45 members' file, ebook and plant_length records, and the 30 floors' pair totals; the plants' totals are verified inside every cell instead because their standing source lengths were never stored frozen; the selected-draw indexes are read, not re-derived; any divergence aborts with nothing written
declared.corpus_source_rule: no new corpus files and no new candidates: the band population is the frozen widened band's declared roster, the plants and plaintext controls are the standing references' frozen files, all stored raw with their markers and processed by the standing declared processing
declared.models_rule: no score table is built or used: the instrument prices count structure only, so the standing add-one and leave-one-out tables play no part anywhere in this artifact
